notes: Points only; Bornu never drawn to the Nile (later tradition only; WP_KANEM_BORNU). 19th-century eastern edge: the Baghirmi and Wadai line (GHA VI p.598, GHA6_BORNU_P594_598, medium); Wadai invaded in 1846 (p.594).
